entities.name: Abu Awn Abd al-Malik ibn Yazid
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Abū ʿAwn ʿAbd al-Malik ibn Yazīd al-Khurasānī was an early supporter of the Abbasids. He participated in the campaigns of the Abbasid Revolution and served as governor of Egypt and Khurasan.
